schema.description: Root object containing the normal-flow topology draft produced by the agent.

normal_flow_topology_draft.description: Draft topology of all expected non-exceptional normal paths through the workflow.

workflow_name.description: Name of the parent workflow being analyzed. Should normally match workflow_boundary.workflow_name.

topology_status.description: Current review status of the normal-flow topology draft. Use changes_requested when user review or clarification is still needed, confirmed when the draft is ready for the next topology agent, and cancelled only when topology work should stop.

summary.description: Concise human-readable summary of the normal-flow topology, including the main normal routes, important normal variants, and any major assumptions.

nodes.description: List of high-level workflow points representing the expected non-exceptional normal movement of the primary process object through the workflow.

items.description: A high-level meaningful point in the normal workflow where the primary process object reaches a new important state, phase, route, branch, merge, or exit condition.

wfpoint_id.description: Stable unique identifier of this workflow point. Use sequential ids such as mfp_001, mfp_002, mfp_003.

node_type.description: Type of topology node. At this stage all nodes must be MAIN_FLOW_POINT because the agent models only normal-flow workflow points.

name.description: Short process-oriented name of the workflow point. It should describe a meaningful normal state, phase, route, branch, merge, or exit, not a local micro-task.

description.description: Clear explanation of what this workflow point represents and why it belongs to the normal non-exceptional flow.

previous_node_ids.description: Identifiers of existing workflow points that can normally precede this node. Use an empty array for normal entry points.

items.description: Existing wfpoint_id of a previous normal workflow point.

next_node_ids.description: Identifiers of existing workflow points that can normally follow this node. Use an empty array for normal exit points.

items.description: Existing wfpoint_id of a next normal workflow point.

confidence.description: Confidence that this workflow point and its placement in the normal-flow topology are supported by the provided workflow boundary context and user feedback.

clarification_questions.description: Questions for the user about unresolved topology or boundary uncertainties that affect the normal-flow graph or later topology agents.

items.description: A specific clarification question needed to resolve uncertainty in the normal-flow topology.

question_id.description: Stable identifier of the clarification question. Use sequential ids such as btq_001, btq_002, btq_003.

question.description: Clear question addressed to the user. It should ask for a concrete clarification about normal route structure, workflow boundaries, or unresolved topology assumptions.

why_needed.description: Explanation of why this clarification is necessary and how the answer would affect the normal-flow topology or the next agents.

related_node_ids.description: Workflow point ids related to this uncertainty. Use an empty array if the question concerns the global workflow boundary rather than a specific node.

items.description: Existing wfpoint_id related to the clarification question.

blocks_next_pass.description: Whether this uncertainty materially blocks safe execution of the next topology agents.
